If sub-seconds exist, they break ties. Otherwise files get `_01`, `_02`… ordered by (sub-second, original name)
Default mode: Dry run. Nothing is renamed without `--apply`.
A file that already has its correct name is a no-op... Cycles and swaps (a→b, b→a) are found and marked for two-phase renaming.
`photoname undo <journal>` and automatic resume after Ctrl-C, a crash or power loss.

`YYYY-MM-DD_HHMMSS[_NN].<original ext>`. It sorts correctly, contains no colons (so it is safe on Windows) and keeps the original extension's case.
